verified_metegs is empty on purpose. At the resolution these crops are delivered at, the type has an x-height of about 20 px and a meteg is a 1–2 px vertical stroke. I could not tell a meteg from the neighbouring vowel strokes or from print noise for any word with enough confidence to list it. Every meteg in fine-346.json is still carried from the primary and unverified. Each one is listed above as a specific human question. Where the print commonly has a meteg but fine-346 has none (הָעֲבוֹדָה, בְּאַהֲבָה, לְרָצוֹן, אָנָּא), that is a question too, not an assumption.
